title: Synctext message 'How long will you be down here for?' with no reception at the Baltic anomaly

tellings.quote: I get a text on my phone and you can ask anybody there with me about this happening and they'll all corroborate this story. And it's a text on Synctext and it says, "How long will you be down here for?"

plain: Michels says that on a trip to the Baltic Sea anomaly, an odd formation spotted on the seabed that some believe is something unusual, his phone got a text on a messaging app he calls Synctext, even though there was no reception, and it asked: "How long will you be down here for?" He tells this as something that happened to him, and he says everyone there with him would back up the story; if true, it would mean something at the site was reaching out to the visitors.
